name: DeKalb-Peachtree Airport

runway.v: longest runway 3R/21L, 6,001 ft x 100 ft (about 1,829 m); 21L has a 1,000 ft displaced threshold

curfew.v: voluntary restriction 23:00-06:00 local every day (emergency and air-ambulance flights exempt); not a ban

ppr.v: aircraft over 75,000 lb maximum take-off weight need prior permission from the airport (770-936-5440); also needed for operations while the tower is closed

hours.v: control tower 06:30-23:00 Monday to Friday and 07:00-23:00 Saturday and Sunday; outside these hours the airspace is uncontrolled

noise.v: noise monitors flag loud events (87 dBA Lmax at residential monitors, 96 dBA at the commercial one); operators get advisory letters, also for flying in the voluntary curfew; maintenance run-ups banned 22:00-07:00
noise.quote: set at 87 dBA Lmax or greater

customs.v: CBP clears aircraft 7 days a week 08:00-16:00 (stated as Eastern Standard Time); ask CBP for permission to land at least 24 hours before arrival; officers meet the aircraft at the FBO named in the notice; no CBP office at the airport; service not guaranteed; outside these hours only under a Reimbursable Service Program agreement
customs.quote: 7 days per week, 0800-1600 Eastern Standard Time (EST)

missing: handling (FBO names only as ramp frequencies)
